name: WA · A2 Media Download
description: WhatsApp support: downloads customer media only from Zernio's authenticated media endpoint and stores validated bytes.

parameters.query:
SELECT app.pending_attachments(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p->'ids', '[]')))::uuid[]) AS list,
       app.setting('attachments') AS cfg FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x

SELECT app.store_attachment_blob((p->>'attachment_id')::uuid, p->>'mime', p->>'data_base64', (p->>'max_bytes')::int,
         ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'allowed'))) AS r FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
SELECT app.mark_attachment_fetch_failed((p->>'attachment_id')::uuid, p->>'status', p->>'error') AS ok FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
